answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 23240 Country: FR Title: My wife and I will soon have a daughter. We want to give her the name "Imane". Is this a good and halal name for a Muslim girl? Question: My wife and I will soon have a daughter. We want to give her the name "Imane". Is this a good and halal name for a Muslim girl? Answer ID: 23240 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1100/890/B=1431) Keep the name Aiman or Yumna instead of Iman. This name would be far better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
